text: The subject is Imran Shafiq, who holds account PK**MUCB****9020 opened on 20 July 2021. The subject declared an occupation as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 2 June 2026 and 30 June 2026, the account recorded 17 credits totalling PKR 28,028,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 26,397,000. The account received 16 cash deposits totalling PKR 27,878,000 across 3 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 30 June 2026, where Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 15 of 16 cash deposits (94%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 27,363,000, which is indicative of repeated deposits just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 3 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 2 days (8 June 2026, 21 June 2026), which is indicative of structuring activity. Credits in the activity window were 186.9 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, suggesting the cash volume is inconsistent with the subject's declared income. A note by Branch Operations on 14 June 2026 recorded that Branch Operations stated the customer asked why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declined to explain the source of the cash, which is consistent with suspected structuring. The pattern of 15 of 16 cash deposits (94%) being between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 3 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Saddar Branch) is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 26,397,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in 6 transactions. Debits equal to 94% of credits were made with a median of 26.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 June 2026. A note by L2 analyst L2 analyst on 28 June 2026 indicates the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
